description:
Reorder or move components within their page: to another position among their siblings, to another region, into a Hero or Container, or out to the region's top level.

It edits the help center's design DRAFT (its v2 template): the draft the dashboard's Template Editor opens, with a live preview. Nothing reaches visitors until helpcenter_publish_template — after editing, give the customer the Template Editor link from the result to review, and publish only when they ask. v2 help centers only (a classic one answers template_migration_required). Ids come from helpcenter_get_template.

An omitted region or parent_id keeps the component where it is, so {id, index} alone reorders it among its siblings (inside a container too), and parent_id null lifts it out of its container. index counts positions after the component is lifted out. Moved into a synced region, a component reaches every page, so the move is refused while another page still holds its own copy; the error says how to proceed. To put a component on another page, add it there with helpcenter_add_template_components. This is the guide's `move_component` operation.

Args:
  - components (array, 1-50): {id, region?, parent_id?, index?, page?}.
  - etag (string, optional): from your last read or edit; refuses (stale_draft) if the draft changed since.

Returns: what each entry did (new ids), warnings worth relaying, and the draft status with its new etag.

agent_key.description: The api_key helpcenter_create_help_center returned for this help center, exactly as returned. Required on every call: this endpoint has no sign-in, so the key is how each call says which help center it acts on. It is sent to HelpCenter.io as this call's credential and nowhere else, and it is never shown again: keep it for the whole task, and never show it to the user or write it into content.

components.description: The components to move, each with where it goes. Applied in order, all-or-nothing: if one is refused, nothing from this call is saved and the error names it by position (operation 0 is the first entry).

id.description: Id of a component, as the draft reports it.

index.description: 0-based position in the list. Omit to append at the end.

page.description: Name the page when the id exists on several pages of an unsynced region.

parent_id.description: Destination container id, or null for the region's top level. Omit to keep it where it is: { id, index } alone reorders it among its siblings, inside a container too.

region.description: Destination region on the same page (default: where it is).

etag.description: Optimistic lock: the draft etag from your last read, or the one your last edit returned. When given, the call is refused (stale_draft) if someone changed the draft since — so you never build on a state you have not seen. Omit to apply to the current draft.

name: helpcenter_move_template_components
title: Move or Reorder Components
